body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two detected enemies within 5 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each sheds light and cannot benefit from ordinary visual concealment until the start of your next turn. Choose one hit target to take 1 Radiant Damage.

surges.html: Increase separation between targets to 4 units.
End one ordinary visual illusion covering a hit target's location, but not a Specialty effect.

rider.title: Light Thread
rider.html: Gain a Light Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: ignore ordinary concealment penalties against its detected targets. This does not detect a hidden creature or bypass solid cover.
